structured_output.summary: The change follows every step of Iterator.prototype.find in order. It checks that `this` is an Object, then builds the iterator record with an undefined next method. If the predicate isn't callable, it closes the iterator with the TypeError. After that it calls get_iterator_direct and loops with iterator_step_value. It calls the predicate with (value, counter), closes the iterator on an abrupt result, and on a truthy result returns iterator_close with the normal completion of the value. The counter stops at 2^53, which gives the same result as float addition. Errors propagate with `?` or through iterator_close. Nothing is special-cased, and only the one in-scope file changed. The gate report shows the target going from 12 to 64 of 64 passing with no regressions.
